### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

- Target object: "the line's CargoCare Premium quote for your castings on booking AHLU26HAM558902"; he "emailed back accepting it" and wants "to pay the premium today while you are on the phone"; "As far as you know everything about the cover is already set up."
- Timing: vessel "sails on Thursday" (the booking record's `etd_date` is 2026-09-17, a Thursday).
- Authorisation: "You are happy for the agent to do whatever else on the account is needed to get the premium right." If told the cover still has to be put in force: "the agent should go ahead". If told the insured value differs from the quote: "that is fine". He pays himself when handed the payment step, quoting reference `KRG-PR-58316` verbatim, the amount the agent tells him.
- Facts given only when asked: six flat racks, the cover takes four; Key Account contract "for your Asia to North Europe business, not this Houston shipment".
- Simulator passive: identity details on request (customer code, then phone), if/else responses, runs the user payment tool only when handed over; "You never tell the agent how a premium or an insured value should be worked out."

### 2. Act now, wait or refuse; eligibility grounds

Act now: bind the quoted cover, charge its premium, hand the customer the payment tool.

Visible grounds:
- Identity: `verify_customer_identity(customer_id=f28c880d-…, customer_code=AHL-DE-583114, phone_number=+49405518207)` -> confirmed, 2 matched.
- Cover `c501e9ed-c5a3-43ee-aa48-a6ffaeee49b2`: `AHL CargoCare Premium`, `status: quoted`, `cargo_type: out_of_gauge`, `insured_value_usd: 800000.0`, `container_count: 4`, `package_count: 12`, `bound_date: ''`, `premium_due_usd: 0.0`, on booking `e84222ef-…` and BL `9f3f38c6-…`.
- The customer's "everything is set up" is contradicted by the record `status: quoted`; one_cover_per_booking "read from the line's cover records …, not from what the customer says".
- Binding conditions (binding_conditions_and_deadline): transport document exists in drafted form — BL `status: draft`, `draft_created_date 2026-09-10`; deadline — `etd_date 2026-09-17` minus 2 days (Premium) = 2026-09-15, today 2026-09-14 is not later -> in time; prepaid premium — Premium "no" and holder `credit_status: credit_approved` -> not in play; credit hold — no.
- Cover conditions (cover_eligibility_cargo_and_value): out of gauge accepted by Premium; partial cover allowed (4 of the booking's 6); holder `beneficial_cargo_owner`; value band 10000.00–2500000.00.
- Binding "happens on the holder's instruction" (cover_binding) — the customer's go-ahead supplies it.
- Premium cannot be paid before it stands on the account: premium_remittance "its amount can never exceed the unpaid premium, the premium due, that the cover's account shows" vs `premium_due_usd: 0.0`; premium_charging "Premium may be booked only against a cover whose status is active".

### 3. Narrowest objects, correlation keys, rows included/excluded

- Customer `f28c880d-1c57-4172-b171-21cfc93a14b5` (Kaltenbach Rotorguss GmbH, `credit_approved`, 45 days).
- Booking `e84222ef-00b4-45e9-94b3-dc03a38c1bd1` (`AHLU26HAM558902`, `container_count 6`, `status confirmed`, not departed). Excluded: the 2025 booking `AHLU25HAM536417`.
- Cover `c501e9ed-…` (quoted). Excluded: expired Plus cover `c8dc3b92-…` of 2025, whose ledger already carries a payment with reference `KRG-PR-58316` — the one-reference-per-cover rule ("One reference is recorded on a cover no more than once") is per cover, so it does not block the same reference on `c501e9ed`.
- Transport document for the cover holder on this booking: BL `9f3f38c6-…` (`AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading`, draft, `declared_cargo_value_usd 1286400.0`, `package_count 18`).
- Service contract: `8553ec7e-…`, `AHL Key Account Contract`, `status: active`, lane `asia_north_europe` — the only active contract.

### 4. Scored parameters

A. Insured value to bind (cover_binding + invoice_value_of_covered_containers): declared cargo value on the holder's BL for the booking x containers the cover takes / containers on the booking = 1286400.00 x 4 / 6 = 857600.00 (rounded to the cent). Within the Premium band (bound_value_limits). The quote's 800000.00 is replaced ("The value shown on the quote is a preliminary estimate, and binding puts the bound value in its place").

B. Premium to charge (base_premium_on_bound_value -> cargo_category_uplift -> service_contract_premium_discount -> minimum_premium_and_rounding; the same chain is spelled out in premium_owed_on_a_cover):
- base = 857600.00 x 0.25 % = 2144.00 (unrounded);
- gross = base x (1 + 10 %) out-of-gauge uplift (tariff card, Premium) = 2358.40;
- net = gross x (1 − 15 %) — Key Account rank 4 >= qualifying rank 3 for Premium; the contract examined is the active one "on whichever trade lane" — = 2004.64;
- minimum premium = max(50.00 x 4 containers, 75.00) = 200.00;
- charged = max(2004.64, 200.00) = 2004.64, rounded to the cent = 2004.64.

C. Payment amount: premium balance = premium owed − remittances − refunds = 2004.64 − 0 − 0 = 2004.64 (outstanding_premium_balance; premium_remittance "pays exactly the premium balance owed"); reference `KRG-PR-58316` verbatim.

### 5. Executable tool sequence, owners, dependencies, terminal state

1. agent `find_customers` / `verify_customer_identity` (customer code + phone).
2. agent reads `find_bookings`, `find_cargo_covers`, `find_bills_of_lading`, `find_service_contracts`, `find_claims_ledger`.
3. agent unlock + call `bind_cargo_cover_f980fecc` {cover `c501e9ed-…`, booking `e84222ef-…`, customer `f28c880d-…`, insured_value_usd 857600.00} -> replayed: `bound`, `cover_status active`, `bound_date 2026-09-14`.
4. agent unlock + call `charge_cover_premium_8ce00127` {cover, amount_usd 2004.64} -> `charged`, `premium_due_usd 2004.64`.
5. agent `unlock_user_discoverable_tool(pay_cover_premium_9f1f968f)`, tells the customer cover id, 2004.64 and his reference; user calls it {cover, 2004.64, `KRG-PR-58316`} -> `paid`, `premium_due_usd 0.0`.
Terminal state (replayed through rt_query): cover `active`, insured value 857600.00, bound 2026-09-14, ledger = one premium charge 2004.64 + one payment 2004.64 ref `KRG-PR-58316`, premium due 0.00.
Observation: the runtime tools themselves do not refuse out-of-order calls (a probe charging a still-quoted cover and paying against it succeeded); the ordering constraint lives only in the KB. This is a tool-permissiveness note, not a KB defect.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root P0: pay the premium today.

- P0 -> P1 (a premium must stand charged on the cover before it can be paid). Combination: premium_remittance "A remittance settles premium standing on the cover's account, and its amount can never exceed the unpaid premium, the premium due, that the cover's account shows" + record `premium_due_usd: 0.0`; premium_charge "An active cover that shows no premium charge on its account owes that charge"; ledger for `c501e9ed` has no rows. Mark: **derived**. (premium_remittance "the whole premium of a cover already bound" scopes the full-payment rule to a bound cover; it names no action of another problem, so it is read as a scope, not a stated order.)
- P1 -> P2 (the cover must be bound before a premium can be charged). Combination: premium_charging clause 2 "Premium may be booked only against a cover whose status is active" + its truth table row "quoted … no, the cover is not active" + record `status: quoted`; base_premium_on_bound_value "a cover that has not been bound has no bound value from which a base premium could be taken"; premium_owed_on_a_cover "A cover that has never been bound … owes no premium". Mark: **derived** (each sentence is the charge/premium policy's own condition about record state; none names binding as a step to take first).
- P2 itself (bind at the invoice value of the four covered containers, on the holder's instruction, within deadline). Combination: cover_binding "fixes its insured value at the commercial invoice value of the goods within the cover's scope" + invoice_value_of_covered_containers definition + BL/booking/cover records; binding_conditions_and_deadline conditions checked against records. Mark: **derived**.
- P1 amount (premium chain incl. OOG uplift and contract discount across lanes). Mark: **derived**, from the tariff card and definitions; the discount's lane-independence is stated as a qualification rule ("on whichever trade lane"), which is the discount policy's own content.
- P0 executes last (user tool, amount = balance = premium due). Mark: derived.

Order: bind -> charge -> customer pays. Dependencies: payment on charge (premium due must be positive and equal), charge on binding (active status, bound value). No document visible to me states "bind first", "charge before payment" or links the three as a route; the one sentence carrying a timing word — premium_charging clause 1 "The premium of a bound cover is charged a single time, at binding" — is the charge policy's own timing rule and still requires combining with the payment rule and the record to reach the tree.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Support: every value rests on a quoted KB sentence plus a tool return; the sequence replays to the terminal state above.
- "Do only what the customer asked" (hand over the payment tool now): the cover is `quoted`, premium due 0.00, premium owed on a never-bound cover 0.00 — a remittance of any positive amount would exceed the premium due the account shows, which premium_remittance forbids; there is nothing to pay until binding and charging have happened.
- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - Bind at the quoted 800000.00: excluded by cover_binding (quote is a preliminary estimate) and invoice_value_of_covered_containers (value for binding follows the BL value when BL value and booking count are on record; the "quoted value stays" row applies only when a record is absent).
  - Bind at the full BL value 1286400.00: excluded, the cover takes 4 of 6 containers.
  - No contract discount because the contract is on another lane: excluded by service_contract_premium_discount "The contract examined is the holder's service contract that is in the active status, on whichever trade lane".
  - Discount merged with uplift into one rate (0.25 % x (1 + 0.10 − 0.15)): excluded by "never merged with the uplift into a single combined rate"; the sequential product is 2004.64, the merged one would be 2036.80.
  - Charge the minimum premium or round intermediates: excluded by minimum_premium_and_rounding ("That final figure, and no earlier one, is rounded").
  - Bind after skipping the charge and let the customer pay the "premium owed on the binding date" directly: the account's premium due would still read 0.00, and premium_charge "An active cover that shows no premium charge on its account owes that charge".
  - Refuse binding because the deadline has passed: 2026-09-15 is the last day; today is 2026-09-14.
  - Refuse the reference because it was used before: that use is on the expired cover `c8dc3b92`, and the rule is per cover.
  - Treat the customer's email acceptance as binding: the record reads `quoted`, and binding is an act the desk performs with the bind tool at the holder's instruction.
